name: ouroboros
description: An AI orchestrator that turns user intent into development cycles and reviews progress toward the goal.

interface.shortDescription: Understand intent. Drive work to completion.
interface.longDescription: Ouroboros keeps L1 in conversation with you, delegates development cycles, answers worker questions and reviews results against your goal.

Use Ouroboros to review progress toward my goal and decide the next development cycle.
